QuestInfo.name: The Lonely Talking Tree
QuestInfo.0: You became friends with #p1032102#, and she wants to introduce you to something else. Wait...someTHING?
QuestInfo.1: #p1032102# introduced you to the #b#p1032112##k at the Shining Forest Path. Since it's stuck there, it tends to get lonely, so go keep the #b#p1032112##k company. The #b#p1032112##k can be found at the #b#m101010000##k.
QuestInfo.2: You met the #p1032112#. You can make friends with a tree, can't you?
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 600 Can proceed to the Talking Tree's Request quest

0.0: Hello, #h0#. There's someone I want you to meet. Are you interested?

yes.0: I want to introduce you to a talking tree I know. It may be a tree, but it has lots to talk about, I assure you. It tends to get lonely, since it's not very mobile. Please find it over at the #b#m101010000##k and say hello.

no.0: Oh, but it's a very special someone. Come back if you change your mind.

1.0: Who's there? Are you here to discuss the finer points of bark aging?\r\n(You introduce yourself) Ah, #p1032102# sent you here? #p1032102# is such a thoughtful young fairy. I appreciate you coming.

yes.0: I've been aching for someone to discuss my theories on proper root maintenance, but alas, no educated travelers have stopped by. It was so good of #p1032102# to send you over, so very good of her.

npc.0: #b#p1032112##k is at the #b#m101010000##k. It tends to get lonely, so please keep it company.
